scenes.setting: Invented statistics — 30 no answer, 68 disasters, 2 successes — fail to shake the vampire, who insists that a forced faith is no faith and that this is for all Sanguine; he leaves thanking Klein and deducting the consultation fee from the suitcase and tin box
scenes.text_anchor: “this is the last pride of a Sanguine.”

scenes.setting: Testing the loop: Derrick fakes hearing the child's plea, and Colin's silver serpents find nothing — then at the Rose Redemption mural he sees a silver-haired, many-winged angel standing over a river that curls back into its own source, and swings the Axe of Hurricane at it
scenes.text_anchor: A cycle! This creates a cycle!
